title: Explicit constants for the two-sided mass bounds (steps 1-2 of the parent)
statement: Let n be a natural number and kappa, omega real numbers with kappa > 0 and omega > 0. Then there are real numbers C and delta_P with 1 <= C, 0 < delta_P, delta_P <= 1/8, delta_P <= kappa and C delta_P <= 1/2 such that for every real t with 0 < t <= delta_P, writing Lambda := t/kappa and (1 - 4t)^n for the n-th natural power: (P) exp(2 Lambda) * ((1 + t)/(1 - 4t)^n * omega) + 2 exp(Lambda) Lambda <= (1 + C t) omega, and (M) (1 - C t) omega <= exp(-Lambda) (omega - Lambda).
